description: A decision and its reason learned as two statements; a direct question that repeats both and an indirect one that shares no word with either. Limit: an answer that needs two memories needs both of them retrieved, and recall matches by word overlap. Failure means: needed-memory-missing names the fact that did not reach the model; offline it shows a retrieval limit, live it also shows whether the model joins the two. Maintenance: no aged records, so on or off changes nothing; seeded distractors are younger than 94 days.
